chunks: O you who believe, remember God a great deal,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do regarding the remembrance of God?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in Surah Al-Ahzab, serves as a foundational command for the believers to maintain constant mindfulness of Allah through frequent Dhikr. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted not merely as verbal recitation but as a state of heart-centered awareness that purifies the soul and prepares the believer for divine proximity, echoing the concept of 'Tazkiyah' (purification).
